nodes.text:
# Icon Preview

A Figma plugin that renders the icon you’re editing **live, at every size that matters** — web, iOS and Android.

[Figma plugin] [Live preview] [Icons]

*Follow the arrows →*

**Icons lie at full size.**

Drawn at 256px, an icon looks crisp on the canvas. Scaled to 16px, strokes blur, counters clog and detail disappears.
Checking sizes meant duplicating the icon 6+ times by hand
Every tweak: re-scale, re-check. A minutes-long feedback loop

nodes.text: What if the preview just… followed you while you edit?
No setup — it detects the icon you’re working on

**One window, every size.**

Select any icon and Icon Preview picks it up, rendering a live grid across the preset sizes used on web, iOS and Android.

nodes.text:
**The loop**

1. Select an icon (frame or group) and run the plugin
2. It renders at every preset web, iOS & Android size
3. Edit, hit **Refresh** — all sizes update
4. Swap icons from the picker — no relaunch

nodes.text: Handles artwork up to 256px — favicons to app icons
Icon picker in the corner to hop between icons

**Dogfooding bonus**

Icon Preview became the test-bed for [Plugma](https://www.plugma.dev/), my plugin-dev CLI — editing the plugin’s code with hot reload while it previews icons in Figma, all on one screen.
